data.title: KSrelief Supplies Drinking Water to Displaced Families in Yemen's Lahj
data.content:
Lahj, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) supplied drinking water yesterday through 20 distribution points in Tuban District, Lahj Governorate, Yemen, benefiting 3,976 individuals from 691 families.
    The distribution was carried out as part of the emergency response project to provide drinking water for displaced persons in Lahj.
    These efforts, undertaken by Saudi Arabia through KSrelief, aim to improve living conditions, ensure access to safe drinking water, strengthen community resilience, and create favorable conditions for recovery in Yemen.
    -- SPA
20:55 Local Time 17:55 GMT
